about: The suite's lanes (Mission 21, Phase 0; scripts/test-lane.ts). On every push: each spec file under push.under ms (ten seconds: the owner, 24 November, "I don't think any test that takes more than 10s to run belongs on core CI") by test/timings.json, every file in test/small/, any spec not yet timed, and the sentinels below. Nightly and on demand: everything, with the long descents and the browser specs. A sentinel is a whole-world or whole-adventure spec kept on every push for what only it proves, each with why; keep the list short (its time is the push lane's). Since 24 November the push lane has no sentinels: each took 13 to 37 s; they are the world canary's (test/canary.json), run before landing by test:changed, and the night's. The images lane (scripts/test-lane.ts images: every *-images.test.ts, skipped without KYRIE_IMAGES) reads the image bytes in assets/, and is in no other lane: CI's images job runs it on the one full checkout, every other job and a builder's worktree being without assets/ (the owner, 25 November).

away.test/discovery-scale.test.ts: A measure of how a time grows with the world: on a loaded CI runner it fails one run in a few (16 November: red on f7c1d0d0 and before, best of three already), and every red push run keeps Pages from deploying. Nightly and on demand, where its trend is read.
away.test/features/conflict/fights-foretold.p: three new lives drawn on s0 and every band of its first dungeon fought ten times each (about a minute): CI's suite and the night's, never the push lane's ten seconds
